variant.briefing:
CFP think they’re safe over at [Location] but we got big plans for them. You’re gonna pave the way for us by heading there and shutting down their comm towers.

There should be a control terminal at the top that you can use to shut the tower down. You get that sorted and they won’t be able to call for backup. Then we can show those skags who this system belongs to.

Most outposts use the same system, so this’ll come in handy next time you want to make sure reinforcements don’t mess with you.

Stows out.
